children: NewHold entered into a prepaid share forward agreement with an unaffiliated stockholder to help support the pending business combination with newcleo. The Seller may purchase up to 7,000,000 NewHold shares and will waive redemption rights, while NewHold prepays the Initial Price (estimated at about $10.65 per share) from its trust at closing. The deal matures up to 24 months post-closing with options for earlier settlement or partial terminations; proceeds and mechanics are designed to comply with tender offer rules. The arrangement is intended to increase cash available to the combined company and stabilize redemptions.
: Prepaid share forward transaction for up to 7,000,000 shares
: Up to 24 months post-closing (early termination permitted)
: Support de-SPAC cash and reduce redemptions
